angle: Slot is the site-section H2. The reader is problem-aware and doubts a website ever brought him a job, so the heading uses the SEO phrase as the label and ends on a call coming in. That ties it to the H1 promise of a ringing phone. Formula: Caples self-interest headline with a specific noun (״החלפת דוד״). The anchor is exact, unbroken and opens the line.

patches.why: Puts the exact anchor first and keeps the current H2's benefit (being found when the customer types the problem). It ends on the call, so the site reads as the means. 10 words, no ״קידום אתרים״, and no ״מקליד״, which the body already uses twice.
